pf.safety.stop_action: no danger words of its own: the generic screen (danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency, crisis words) is always on
pf.safety.infested: furniture with bed bugs, fleas or moths, or with mold, is not taken: said ahead, it is declined plainly; found at the shop or at a home, the work stops, the piece is sealed in a bag, a written note and photo go to the customer, nothing is charged for what wasn't done, and the owner calls

pf.safety.heavy: a piece too heavy or too wide for the door or the stairs is measured ahead; two people carry a sofa; the truck takes one large piece per trip

pf.visit.check_in: the check-in code at the counter; a walk-in drop-off is checked in at the counter at once; at a house call, the code at the door
pf.visit.intake: a ticket per piece: condition photos from the front, back and underneath, the frame checked for cracks, seams checked for pests, the fabric choice, and the date it is needed by; the customer keeps the claim ticket
pf.visit.estimate: written, item by item (labor, fabric, foam, springs), before any work; the customer says yes to all, to some items, or not today; good for 7 days
pf.visit.fabric: fabric is ordered after the yes, and after the deposit where there is one; a fabric that is late or discontinued: Rosie texts a new date or choices, and nothing changes without a yes
pf.visit.added_work: springs, frame cracks or rotted webbing found when the old fabric comes off are texted with a price first; nothing extra without a yes; no answer in 2 days: finished as quoted, with the problem noted
pf.visit.ready: READY texts the pick-up hours, anything due and the held-until date; a large piece is delivered on a booked day
pf.visit.pick_up: with the claim ticket or the code; a check of the fabric and seams at the counter; handed over once anything due is paid
pf.visit.done_proof: the code at pick-up checks the visit in; at a house call, DONE after the check at the delivery
pf.visit.claims: damage reported within 7 days of pick-up or delivery; the owner decides with the shop's claims policy, never more than the piece's value
pf.visit.unclaimed: pieces not picked up: reminders at 30 and 60 days after READY, then a final written notice with the date before anything is donated or sold at 90 days, as the state's unclaimed-property rules allow; the owner decides
pf.visit.house_call: the upholsterer looks at the furniture at the home, prices each item, and the truck takes the pieces to the shop; they come back on a booked delivery, with a check

pf.money.before: nothing taken at the shop; a set of 4 chairs takes a $40 deposit that orders the fabric; a sofa priced from photos takes a $160 deposit once the owner OKs the price; a house call saves a card for the $89 visit
pf.money.deposit: the deposit comes off the price; the rest is paid at pick-up or on the bill after delivery; deposit cap: from the state form
pf.money.after: the rest at the counter at pick-up; for a house call or a delivery, the bill Rosie texts after the furniture comes back
pf.money.fees: no late-cancel or no-show fee at the shop; at a house call, the $89 visit fee for a late cancel or a no-show, only if Sam confirms; it is credited to the work when the work is done; after a deposit, what may be kept is the fee, never more than was paid
pf.money.materials: fabric, foam and springs are added at cost, shown in the written price, with a yes first
pf.money.cancel_after_ok: the deposit back, less the fabric already cut or ordered; money kept: from the state form
pf.money.tax: where the state taxes the work (the owner's setting)

never_in_text: Photos of the inside of the home
pf.messages.minors: texts about a child's furniture go to the parent who booked

pf.staff.who_oks: the owner OKs prices over $500, sofas and any fee
pf.staff.stand_in: dining chairs and cushions: any upholsterer; sofas, springs and frames: only the master upholsterer

pf.rules.written_price: switch: a written price before work, above an amount: from the state form; the shop writes every item anyway
pf.rules.fees_in_first_price: switch: every required fee, like the visit fee, inside the first price: from the state form
pf.rules.stuffed_goods: switch: the state's registration and labels for stuffed or upholstered goods: from the state form; the law tag on a cushion or a seat is never removed

notes:
BUILT Oct 27 2026 (P3 new profession D3, REDESIGN 2 master, frozen). No old flowchart or sample plug-in existed (a new profession), so the plug-in is built from the trade's norm. Start: the refitted tailor (from: tailor). Style Drop-off, pattern dropoff.
Why tailor: upholstery runs like a tailor's shop. A small piece (a chair seat, a cushion) is looked at, priced item by item in writing, left, READY, and picked up. Flow B is the tailor's shape too: a house call looks at the furniture and prices it, the truck takes it to the shop, and it comes back on a booked delivery (own steps B8-x01 and B8-x02). A sofa is priced from photos first (the photos fact).
Facts: dropoff, photos, extrawork. No switches ($2 applies). Settings: arrive A set start, B 2-hour window; cutoff A 24 hours before, B 6pm the day before (the route is planned the evening before).
Money A (3 paths): list|none|counter (main: a dining chair seat re-covered with the customer's fabric, $35, nothing taken, paid at pick-up), visit|none|counter (a wingback chair priced at the counter after a look: armchair re-cover $110 + new webbing $15 = $125, the customer says yes first), list|deposit|counter (a set of 4 dining chairs, $140 labor: a $40 deposit orders the fabric, the $100 rest at pick-up; the late-cancel fee is the $40 deposit).
Money B (3 paths): visit|card|bill (main: a house call for an armchair and a footstool; only the $89 estimate visit is promised, with a card saved for it; each item priced at the visit: armchair $165 + footstool $80 = $245; the bill after the pieces come back, the fee credited to the work), list|card|bill (a set of 4 dining chair seats, $179, picked up, re-covered at the shop and delivered back), photos|deposit|bill (a sofa reupholstery priced from photos at $640: Sam OKs it, a $160 deposit orders the fabric, the $480 rest on the bill after delivery). The $89 is the late-cancel and no-show fee for a house call, charged only on Sam's yes.
Master numbers are kept in flow B ($89, $179, $150, $199, $245, $165, $80, $160, $640, $480, $540), so every master line that names a price shows the shop's own; only '$120 an hour' became '$75 an hour'.
Licenses: none for upholstery or furniture repair or for any person; the company gives its business registration, and the stuffed-goods registration where the state requires one (S1-61 asks for both). S1-60 '1 A license' and S2-28 '1 Yes, each one' off, S11-42 license branches off. The second kind of work (furniture repair) is registration only (S1-38 asks 'license or registration only?'). Fake numbers use EX-1042 style. No state, law or number from one state. The law tag on a cushion is never removed (an improper request, B4-117 example).
Safety and who must not be booked: no danger words of its own (the generic screen is on); 'Safety steps, then go on' is off. Furniture with bed bugs, fleas, moths or mold is not taken: said ahead, it is declined plainly (A7-13 example); found at the shop (A8-35) or at a home (B8-30) the work stops, the piece is sealed in a bag, a written note and photo go to the customer, nothing is charged for what wasn't done, and the owner calls. Adults book; a parent books a child's furniture; no child is left at the shop.
Own steps: A8-x01 (the ticket: photos front, back and underneath, frame and seams checked for pests), B8-x01 (the furniture signed out to the truck), B8-x02 (the delivery with a code and a check, then DONE). Words ops: A8-35, A10-23 (reminders at 30 and 60 days, a final written notice before the 90-day donation or sale, the owner decides), A7-13 (bed bug example), A7-70, B8-41 (DONE moved to the delivery day), B8-47, S11-48.
Dates run forward: visit Thu Oct 22, furniture signed out 9:30am (B8-x01), delivery Thu Nov 12 8:15am (B8-x02), DONE 9:10am (B8-41, time words op). The tailor's own-step dates were not copied.
Not built: car seats, outdoor cushions, antique restoration (a possible next kind of work), storage fees, mail-in.
Known master limits (see the log): hard-coded 'haircut' words in A4-14, A4-42, A5-05, A6-14 on the visit and deposit paths; the S1-13 owner replies and read-backs; S12-09 / S12-10 price the second service at the first one's price; S12-19 and S11-99 license steps are not gated by the plug-in.
